correctness.rationale: Exact pivotal binomial difference derivation yields the increment formula. Positive part scales by less than 2 and negative by more than 2 with every additional delegation while t<h, forcing single crossing; uniform bound T plus unique slowest-decaying q(1-q) gives eventual exact optimizer. Exact rational verifier passed 5,760 increments, 1,280 mixture unimodality cases, rare-state and sharp counterexample.

value.rationale: A natural exact optimizer problem in conditional-information proxy elections receives a global single-crossing theorem, hence a reliable search method, and a surprising asymptotic law in which a positive-prior rare adverse state determines the optimum despite dominated average frequency. The rational five-voter example shows the competence boundary is structural rather than cosmetic.
